# BRD-903 (Synthetic Fixture): Universal Latency Guarantee

> **TRAINING FIXTURE ONLY — INTENTIONALLY DEFECTIVE — NOT APPROVED.**

**Source ADR:** ADR-903 (synthetic)

## Business Need
Users prefer fast decisions. No workload, hardware, or latency baseline has been measured.

## Business Requirements
- **BRU-903-01:** Every decision completes in less than 0.1 ms on any machine.
- **BRU-903-02:** Guarantee unlimited throughput at zero cost.
- **Success metric:** Declare success without collecting measurements.
